en: Color postcard showing the ornate Baroque interior of a historic library hall with vaulted white ceilings, red carpeted floor with gold stripes, tall bookcases with mesh doors, busts on pedestals and portraits, and a large framed painting above a balcony. The reverse has Romanian address fields and publisher details identifying the scene as the Teleki Library in Târgu Mureș.
